newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound almost stable against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound almost stable against dollar.

text.p: The Egyptian pound remained almost unchanged against the dollar on Tuesday in a private sector market long on the U.S. currency, bankers said.
"The market is still liquid in dollars," one banker said.
Four actively trading banks quoted the dollar at between 3.3890 and 3.3915 bid and 3.3910 and 3.3935 pounds offered in the interbank market.
The average rate was 3.39075 bid and 3.392625 offered, compared to 3.390625 pounds bid and 3.392125 pounds offered on Monday.
The central bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.388863 pounds buy and 3.393994 pounds sell.
